dataList.content:
There already was a group of people by the fireplace.
壁炉前已经有先于我们抵达的人。
dataList.place:
Wuthering Heights Fireplace
呼啸山庄 壁炉前

dataList.content:
Master Linton...
林顿家主……

So you've arrived...
最后……你还是来了……

This can't be a coincidence, can it? I suppose you're also trying to enter the basement.
我们并非因为巧合在此碰面的吧……你的目的地也是地下室吧。

Master Linton, what are you hiding in the basement?
林顿大人，地下室里究竟隐藏着什么？

... I see that they have gotten their hands on it first. Despite the fact that you had the head start.
……明明是你们先进房间的，结果该找的东西还是被他们捷足先登了啊。

dataList.title:
Edgar Family
埃德加家族
dataList.content:
Our most profound apologies, Master Linton...
万分抱歉，林顿家主……

... Return that diary to me.
……把那本日记还给我。

Why must we?
我们有这么做的理由吗？

... Is it that unreasonable for a husband to request that you return his loving wife's memento to his hands?
……丈夫要求归还深爱妻子的遗物，这是什么不合理的要求吗？

Don't provoke me.
不要再刺激我了。

Tell me why Catherine died.
告诉我为什么凯瑟琳会死。

And like I said earlier... I won't believe a word from your gob until I see her body for myself.
同我先前所说过的一样……在亲眼看到尸体之前，你那嘴里吐出来的话我一句也不会相信。

Even your claim that she married you.
包括你说的什么结婚之类的话……全部。

How desperate.
何等可悲。

Allow me to offer you an alternative. Go hide in some corner of this manor. Wait until the lightning strikes seven times... Then take the Golden Bough Catherine left you, leave, and never return to this place ever again.
让我来给你个建议怎么样？在这座宅邸里找个角落窝着直到闪电第七次落下为止……然后按凯瑟琳的遗言拿着金枝滚出去，别再回到这里来。

It is what you do best, Heathcliff—turning tail and hiding. Shrouding your shameful, tear-soaked face from the world, fleeing from the beatings, abandoning Catherine... because you were too busy running away from the gnawing hounds.
这不是你的拿手好戏吗，希斯克利夫。你为了掩饰你的泪水，为了远离那些鞭打，为了逃离那些猎犬的撕咬……而抛弃凯瑟琳离开。

... Keep talking, 'Young Master' Edgar. And you'll find that I'm no longer that weak child you once knew.
……埃德加少爷，睁大你的眼睛好好看看，我还是不是那个有气无力的小不点。

Well... I'm not so sure what has really changed about you since then, Heathcliff.
谁知道呢。我的眼中……你什么变化都没有，希斯克利夫。

And those... cheap, tacky letters you sent...?
另外，你寄来的那些……廉价又俗气的信件……

All burned with the rest of the trash in the incinerator.
都被扔到焚化炉里烧掉了。和垃圾一起。
